name: Gemcitabine + Capecitabine (GemCap, ESPAC-4)
cyclesNote: Adjuvant after resection; about 6 cycles (24 weeks) to complete roughly 6 months of perioperative therapy, deducting any neoadjuvant months given.

institution.provenance: ONCOTREE grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: The gemcitabine/capecitabine backbone is not biomarker-restricted; it is an adjuvant option for reduced-fitness patients not suited to an adjuvant triplet. Consider DPYD genotype/phenotype before a fluoropyrimidine (capecitabine).

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: moderate emetic risk on gemcitabine days; give guideline-tier antiemetic prophylaxis.

supportiveCare: Counsel on capecitabine hand-foot syndrome, diarrhoea and mucositis; interrupt and dose-reduce per grade.
Screen for DPYD deficiency before starting a fluoropyrimidine.
Monitor for myelosuppression on gemcitabine days.
monitoring: liver and renal function before each cycle
capecitabine tolerance (hand-foot, diarrhoea, mucositis) each cycle
CA 19-9 and imaging on surveillance schedule

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 2+ hand-foot syndrome, diarrhoea, mucositis, or cytopenias
doseModificationRules.text: Review required. Interrupt capecitabine and reduce on recovery per fluoropyrimidine toxicity grading; hold gemcitabine on a treatment day for cytopenias. Physician decides.

drugs.name: Gemcitabine
drugs.notes: Gemcitabine 1,000 mg/m2 IV on days 1, 8 and 15 of a 28-day cycle. Source: adjuvant standard of care (GemCap / ESPAC-4 style) per NCCN Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma / DeVita general reference (own wording).

drugs.name: Capecitabine
drugs.notes: Capecitabine 830 mg/m2 orally twice daily (about 1,660 mg/m2 total per day) on days 1 to 21 of a 28-day cycle; dosePerUnit is the per-dose (twice-daily) mg/m2. Round to available tablet strengths. Screen DPYD. Source: adjuvant GemCap (ESPAC-4 style) per NCCN Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma / DeVita general reference (own wording).
